chinese: 救命！我生活中的规矩太多了！
english: Help! There are too many rules in my life!

chinese: 每天早上，我必须在吃早餐前整理好床铺。
english: Every morning, I have to make my bed before breakfast.

chinese: 我必须匆忙赶去学校，因为我上学不能迟到。
english: I have to hurry to school because I can’t be late for school.

chinese: 在学校时，我也绝对不能在课堂上使用手机。
english: When I’m at school, I mustn’t use my phone in class either.
And I have to wear the uniform.
After school, there are even more rules!

chinese: 我必须先完成家庭作业。
english: I have to finish my homework first.

chinese: 只有在练完钢琴之后，我才能打篮球。
english: I can only play basketball after I practise the piano.

chinese: 我不能在工作日和朋友出去玩。
english: I can’t hang out with my friends on weekdays.

chinese: 我知道有些规定很重要，
english: I know some rules are important,

chinese: 但这太糟糕了！我该怎么办？
english: but this is awful! What can I do?
